description: PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "what stocks is Congress buying/selling right now". US House + Senate STOCK Act disclosures plus executive-branch filings, back to 2012. Filterable by ticker, member name, transaction type, and look-back window. Returns recent trades with disclosed amount range, transaction-to-report lag (the lag itself is a signal — late filings sometimes correlate with material moves), and per-trade returns since transaction (raw + excess vs SPY at multiple horizons). Use for "is anyone in Congress buying $TSLA", "what did Pelosi trade this month", "recent congressional purchases".

days.description: Look-back window in days. Default 30. Can go back to 2012.

limit.description: Max trades to return. Default 50, max 500.

member.description: Filter by representative — full name, last name, or canonical filer id. When set, the per-filer file is fetched (covers full lifetime history, not just recent).

ticker.description: Filter to one ticker (case-insensitive, e.g. "TSLA"). When set, the cheapest path is taken (per-ticker file).

transaction.description: Filter to transaction type, "purchase" or "sale" (substring-matched against the full type label).

name: politician_recent_trades
title: Politician Recent Trades
